# 249 # Extension Must Be Active: NONE

# Test Case Rule: RULE 167: When an SRET instruction is executed, the privilege level is set to user mode if the SPP bit in mstatus is 0, otherwise to supervisor mode if the SPP bit in mstatus is 1, and then the SPP bit in mstatus is set to 0.
